title: Engineless Artifacts and App State Machines
description:
Artifacts must not have an engine — only a schema (snapshot, diff, mutations, inferences) and an io system. Every app has an engine which IS a state machine, controlled by the app, communicating bidirectionally. `machine` becomes a core framework-provided full-blown state machine implementation (promoted from the plugin-private `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🖍️draw/🔄️fsm/`). State machines emit events on transitions: mutations (shared, VCS-tracked) and presence (ephemeral, broadcast within a space). Four state classes — persisted-shared (artifacts), persisted-local (config), ephemeral-local, ephemeral-shared (cursors, cameras) — and one field may belong to several at once (camera is persisted locally AND broadcast ephemerally), declared once rather than copy-pasted.

Three workstreams:
A) Dissolve 95 populated artifact engine dirs (153,457 LOC) per a mechanical D0-D6 classification procedure; repeal the three policy rules that currently MANDATE the dir; add a forbidding ratchet.
B) Promote the draw fsm crate to `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🔄️machine/` (+ derive proc-macro sibling); add `AppMachine`/`Views`/`MachineResidence`/`NoMachine` to the plugin crate; fill the 53 empty app engine slots with handcrafted statecharts.
C) `StateClass` becomes `StateClassSet` (one field, several classes); invert the config/presence validator from equality to membership; revive the dead presence lane (`Emit` 4th param, `PresenceView`, `PresenceStore`, `dispatch_emit` arm, `presence_pack` broadcast).

Approved plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/artifacts-must-not-have-magical-hanrahan.md
Peer sessions: APA #2549, UCAS #2548, SMO #2545, IIF, DKM #2550 — negotiate as a peer, never supersede.
summary:
**Core mission complete: 0 pre-existing artifact `⚙️engine` directories remain, down from 95 at start (~153,457 LOC relocated). 1 transitional exception, owned by a different ticket (#DKM's `DISSOLVE-KERNELS-AND-MODULES-INTO-EVENT-SOURCED-ARTIFACTS`), deliberately left untouched — see `📓️results.md` for why.**

## Thesis delivered
An artifact is a `🧬️schema` (snapshot, diff, mutations, inferences) plus a `🚪️io` system — never an engine. The taxonomy SSOT now enforces this directly: `artifactComponentDirs`/`artifactChildDirs`/`subsetComponentDirs`/`subsetChildDirs` contain no `⚙️engine`; `appChildDirs` still requires one (apps own behaviour); `taxonomyLeafParentDirs` keeps module-level engines legal (pure algorithms one level up). Two mandating policy rules deleted (one gated at `high` on a *missing* engine — the trap that made a naive first deletion dangerous); one forbidding rule installed, ridden from `low` (95-item census) down to a clean repo.

## Verified, not asserted
- `semio-s-plugin-stdio` (the largest, most cross-coupled block — 41 of the 95 directories, ~32k LOC, 15 external consumer plugins) — re-verified fresh minutes before close (new `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, disk confirmed healthy) after a 9.5-hour gap and a reported disk-full incident elsewhere in the tree: `Finished` in 4m25s, exit 0, zero errors.
- 11 cross-plugin consumer crates checked directly post-dissolution: 7 clean (`fem`,`cad`,`layout`,`puzzle`,`raster`,`shooting`,`gis`); 2 with errors confirmed **out of scope** via `git log`/live-session correspondence (`draw`: unrelated borrow-lifetime issue from another session's edit; `lowpoly`: DKM's own in-flight `semio_framework_3d::brep` work); 1 (`trinity`) timed out on lock contention, no verdict claimed.
- `🔄️machine` framework module shipped in Rust + TypeScript twin, 31+30 tests green, both compiler-verified independent of stdio.
- Zero dangling `#[path]` glue mounts repo-wide (peaked at 20 mid-session from simultaneous agent session-limit kills; fully repaired).
- Zero bare `io_registry::entries()` calls against 44/45 artifact roots carrying a shadowing wrapper that silently rebinds if left unqualified — the single most dangerous defect class found this session.

## Cross-ticket coordination
Six-plus concurrent sessions (APA #2549, UCAS #2548, SMO #2545, IIF #2546, DKM, a demonstrator/architecture session) shared this tree throughout. Notable exchanges: caught and helped repair a stdio module-path misdiagnosis that cost APA 9 files; caught SMO's 672 false-positive breaches from a repointed policy rule before they shipped; unblocked IIF's hard-gating taxonomy flip by finding and relocating energy's 50 misfiled inference directories; fixed my own wave's regressions (norm, remodel) using the same compiler-first discipline demanded of every dispatched agent; declined to unilaterally dissolve a live, documented, correctly-mounted transitional engine directory belonging to DKM's ticket, flagging it instead and adopting DKM's more precise closing framing verbatim.

- `trinity`'s consumer-crate compile status — contention-blocked, never verified either way.
- `draw`'s borrow-lifetime bug and any residual mutation-vocabulary fallout from concurrent tickets (SMO/DKM) — out of this ticket's scope, several already resolved live during this session (writer's `WriterMutation` issue self-resolved via SMO's landing).
